plugins.name: readback
plugins.description: Forces active engagement with AI output: a real multiple-choice decision before a judgment call gets made on your behalf, and a graded understanding check before a finished deliverable counts as done.

plugins.name: explaining-plainly
plugins.description: Explains code findings, bugs and design tradeoffs in chat the way the reader experiences them rather than the way the code is written: workflow narrative first, code citations as separate evidence, plain-text diagrams for sequences and before/after comparisons.

plugins.name: notify
plugins.description: Desktop and phone notifications when Claude finishes a turn or needs your input. Phone push goes through ntfy, with the full reply, and /notify:setup walks you through subscribing.

plugins.name: demo-page
plugins.description: Turns a system, a flow, a piece of work or a comparison into a short, visual one-page artifact you can present in a 5-minute demo, with one thesis, a few sections and only claims backed by what was read.

plugins.name: reviewer
plugins.description: A code reviewer for any repository. Reviews a PR, a branch or your working tree, skips what other reviewers already said, checks against what merged into the base and against open PRs, verifies each finding at the PR head, drafts a kind review that is posted only on your go-ahead, and learns from finished PRs.
